messages:
Maya: Found a tiny plush llama by the 3rd floor coffee station. No tag, just majestic. Anyone claim?
Josh: Not mine but 100% deserves a name. I vote 'Cache' because it hides in corners. :llama: :cache: (not a real emoji)
Linh: lol Cache Llama. Can we hold a coronation ceremony during lunch? I can bring glitter.
Sanjay: Coronation sounds dangerously official. Will there be a scepter? Also who provides the crown, rubber-band engineering?
Katie: I hereby nominate Josh as Grand Llama Steward based on his snack-hoarding record. :raised_hands:
Josh: I accept the heavy burden. Responsibilities: protect snacks, approve latte temperatures, and ensure llama is within 10ft of any meeting with pastries.
Maya: Official schedule: 12:15pm today in kitchen. BYOC (bring your own crown).
Linh: Adding a poll: "What should we inscribe on the llama's name tag?" Options: 1) Cache 2) Nibbleton 3) Sir/Madam Fluffington 4) LlamaGPT
SnackBot: Poll created: "Llama name" — react with :one: :two: :three: :four: to vote. Free donuts for voters.
Sanjay: I'll carve tiny swords out of coffee stirrers for guards.
Katie: Also proposing a tiny throne (cardboard + duct tape). Voting yes.
Josh: If we do a coronation, can someone livestream to teammates overseas? @Linh can you handle a quick phone tripod?
Linh: Yep, I will. Also will bring glitter glue (low fallout).
Maya: This is our new mascot until proven otherwise. Photo ops required.
SnackBot: Reminder: Kitchen closes at 1pm. Coronation must finish before cleaning. :broom:
Josh: Pressing issue: crown material. Options: aluminum foil, post-it note, or the fancy Starbucks sleeve?
Katie: Starbucks sleeve crown is peak indie. I have extras.
Sanjay: See everyone at 12:15. If anyone steals the llama on the way, the coronation committee will enact immediate squirrel justice.
Maya: (reaction) :laughing: :llama:
Linh: I'll add a tiny name tag template to #random-pics after the ceremony.
Josh: Long live Llama Cache. Coronation playlist suggestions welcome. I call dibs on 'Eye of the Tiger' ironically.
Maya: Playlist: mix of circus themes + 80s rock. Perfect.
SnackBot: Donuts: 6 glazed, 6 chocolate. Glazed reserved for crowned guests.
Katie: Photo checklist: 1) Llama on throne 2) Crown on 3) Josh dramatically holding a scepter (or cereal bowl) 4) Mandatory group selfie
Sanjay: Bring the cereal bowl. It's essential theater.
Maya: See you soon. Long live the plush llama.
